planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the reaction diagram and ignore all curved arrows. Read the small carboxylic acid fragment in the lower middle/right: an R-substituted carbonyl carbon double-bonded to O and single-bonded to an O-H group. Treat R, the acyl chloride reagent, chlorinated aromatic ring, and triethylamine label as contextual/reactant features not part of the requested minimal SMILES answer.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and specifically says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES notation: a carbonyl carbon is written as C(=O), and a single-bonded oxygen attached to that carbon is appended as O. The generic R substituent and explicit H on hydroxyl are normally omitted in the fragment SMILES.
